introduction.text: The Basilica di Sant'Andrea della Valle is a major Baroque church in Rome, serving as the seat of the Theatine order and a model for later churches.

history.description: In 1582, Donna Costanza Piccolomini d'Aragona bequeathed her palace and the adjacent church of San Sebastiano to the Theatine order to build a new church dedicated to Saint Andrew.
Construction began around 1590 under Giacomo della Porta and Pier Paolo Olivieri, with patronage of Cardinal Gesualdo.
Work restarted by 1608, financed by an endowment of over 150,000 gold scudi, and led by Cardinal Alessandro Peretti di Montalto.
Giovanni Lanfranco completed the lavish dome decoration in 1627.
The interior of the church was completed by 1650, with later changes by Francesco Grimaldi.
The Baroque facade was added between 1655 and 1663 by Carlo Rainaldi.
The altar in the Chapel of the Madonna della Purità was consecrated in 1725.
Frescoes in the left transept were painted in 1770 by Alessio D'Elia.
A two‑manual pipe organ was built in 1845.
The Chapel of Our Lady of the Sacred Heart was designed 1887–1889 by Aristide Leonori.
The church was designated a cardinal titular church on 12 March 1960.

design.description: The church’s Baroque facade, added 1655-1663, was designed by Carlo Rainaldi.
The dome’s frescoes, completed in 1627, were painted by Giovanni Lanfranco.
A two‑manual pipe organ, built in 1845, remains in the basilica.
A fountain attributed to Carlo Maderno stands on the square in front of the basilica.

art.description: Domenichino painted frescoes in the dome and apse, including the History of Sant'Andrea and Virtues.
Mattia Preti frescoed Crucifixion, Martyrdom and burial of Sant'Andrea in the apse walls (1650–1651).
Antonio Raggi sculpted the marble relief Angel Urges Sacred Family to Flee to Egypt (1675) in the Ginetti Chapel.
Bernini’s style influenced sculptures such as the angel in the Ginetti Chapel and other works.
Gregorio De Rossi produced bronze copies of Michelangelo’s Pietà, Leah and Rachel (1616) in the Strozzi Chapel.
